meta.title: SunmoonAI Web
meta.description: A production-oriented Next.js frontend paired with a dedicated Nest Web Backend.

public.title: A dependable foundation for product web applications
public.description: Public content, authenticated workspaces, API access and live interactions use explicit rendering, security and ownership boundaries.

knowbots.title: Experts
knowbots.intro: An expert follows its author's method with the author's data. It appears here after it is built in knowlab and passes its tests.
knowbots.loadFailed: Could not load. Refresh and try again.
knowbots.fromWorkbench: From the workbench: pick a version and choose “Use this one” to go back.
knowbots.summonFailed: Could not go back to the workbench. Try again.
knowbots.stopFailed: Could not stop it. Try again.

experts.demoUnavailable: This is a display example. It is not available for commissioning.

marketUi.demandMessages: Messages on this demand (visible to everyone)
marketUi.privateMessages: Messages only you two can see
marketUi.proposal: What you can do and how
marketUi.attachHint: If it is not made yet, leave this empty and tell the buyer once it is listed

reviewStatus.revoked: Revoked (see the note; edit and submit again to be reviewed)

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.lead: Material sellers offer. Once bought, knowbase gives you the right to use it; it shows under “Purchased” in your knowbase library and you can download it.
knowledge.bought: Bought; it is under “Purchased” in your knowbase library.
knowledge.boughtFailed: Not bought: the seller's file is no longer there. Anything already granted stays under “Purchased”.
knowledge.noPayment: This period only records trades; nothing is charged.
knowledge.boughtNotForSale: Not bought: the seller no longer sells this file. Anything already granted stays under “Purchased”.
knowledge.where: It goes under “Purchased” in your knowbase library; to use it in knowbench or knowlab, show it to that app in knowbase first.

shops.title: Shops
shops.lead: Every user has one shop in the market, holding their supply (experts, knowledge) and the demands they make public. Only shops with something on show are listed, by time or name; nothing is recommended.
shops.empty: No shop has anything on show yet.

myShop.title: My shop
myShop.name: Shop name
myShop.nameHint: Your nickname by default; words like 'stock tips' or 'recommend' are not allowed. Changes are kept on record.
myShop.listed: Something is on show: the shop is listed on the home page.
myShop.notListed: Nothing on show yet: the shop is not listed on the home page and cannot be found.
myShop.suspended: The platform suspended this shop: {note}. While suspended you cannot submit, ask to go public, post demands or respond, and others cannot buy or ask; past trades stand.
myShop.view: See the shop as others do

demands.title: Demand hall
demands.lead: Buyers post demands, sellers respond, and the buyer chooses one.
demands.publicToShopHint: Either way it goes into the demand hall without your name; ticked, it also shows on your shop page.

mine.knowledgeLead: Write listings from material you handed to knowmart in knowbase; operators review them before they go up.
mine.descriptionHint: How many files, which formats, what they cover
mine.noFiles: Nothing handed to knowmart yet. In your knowbase library, hand the material you want to sell to knowmart first.
mine.sampleHint: A few pages or lines buyers can see before buying
mine.rightsHint: Confirm you have the right to sell this material
mine.expertsLead: Your experts come from knowlab after testing. Going public needs an approved publisher (and a license in licensed categories) and operator review; the price is per ask.
mine.chooseCategory: Choose a category before requesting public
mine.filesHint: You can sell material you uploaded yourself and licensed “for sale” in knowbase.
mine.notForSale: (not licensed for sale; change it in knowbase)
mine.notYours: (not uploaded by you; cannot be sold)

bought.failed: Not bought: the seller's copy is no longer there
bought.notForSale: Not bought: the seller no longer sells this file

publisher.title: Publisher and licenses
publisher.lead: One publisher per shop. Register before making experts public or listing knowledge: individuals with their real name, others with a business licence; licensed categories also need a licence. A changed publisher is reviewed again and kept on record; trades name the publisher at the time. Photos are seen only by reviewers and cleared a year after review.
publisher.name: Public name
publisher.idHint: Only a masked form is kept; operators check the number against the photo
publisher.documentsLead: JPEG, PNG or PDF, up to 5 MB.
publisher.licensesLead: Securities/futures advisory and fund categories need a license; you are reminded 30 days before it expires, and after that public experts go back to private and knowledge is delisted.
publisher.licensePhotoFirst: Upload a license photo above first (choose “License”).
